newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boyd Gaming cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boyd Gaming cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Boyd Gaming Corp to hold from buy.
-- said trimmed the 1997 earnings estimate to $0.27 a share from $0.49 a share and the 1998 earnings estimate to $0.30 a share from $0.60 a share.
-- said does not expect Boyd's properties will show significant near-term earnings improvement due to recent and expected supply increases in most of the company's markets.
-- said recent and planned openings of new gaming facilities will continue to hurt some of Boyd's properties.
